tasks.short: Prepare promotional plans, sales literature, media kits and advertising contracts.

steps.what: Read the opportunity and confirm the campaign brief.
Find current audience figures, rate cards and approved examples.
Write the promotional plan around the customer's objectives.

loop.input: Campaign brief and versioned source pack.
loop.output: Promotional plan with supported claims and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Validate figures against sources; seller checks positioning and suitability.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing facts return to the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: Customer objectives require tailored prose; fixed templates cover only the structure.

steps.what: Adapt sales literature to the proposed campaign.

loop.input: Promotional plan, approved copy and brand template.
loop.output: Tailored sales literature within the approved layout.
loop.check: Check claims, mandatory wording and layout; seller reviews tone.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported claims remain flagged.
loop.why_not_simpler: The customer narrative varies beyond field substitution.

steps.what: Assemble the media kit with specifications, audience figures and samples.
Populate the advertising contract with agreed commercial terms.
Check commercial terms and resolve contract exceptions.
Review the customer pack and send materials or request signature.

tasks.design: A guided form in the {CRM} collects the campaign brief and pulls approved material from the {DOCS} and {ADS}. Templates generate media kits and contracts, while bounded drafting loops prepare tailored plans and literature. Clearance rules route exceptions, and the seller approves customer delivery through the {EMAIL} or {ESIGN}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience figures, approved copy and contract fields lived in separate places. Bespoke documents made template upkeep expensive.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing templates and signature workflows cover standard documents. AI-assisted coding lowers the cost of connecting sources; bounded drafting handles customer-specific prose.
tasks.still_hard: Audience definitions, stale claims and negotiated rights need care. Contract exceptions need commercial or legal judgement, and customer data needs GDPR-compliant access and retention.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the customer's commercial objective and make credible promises about what the advertising can achieve.

ambition.what: A quarterly campaign refresh pack for smaller existing advertisers.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time assembling files and more time shaping campaigns. They can offer refresh packs within approved commercial limits; discount and contract authority stays unchanged.

reach.task: Prepare the advertising booking order from the signed contract.
reach.learn: Required booking fields, billing references and the boundary between agreement and confirmed inventory.

evidence.claim: Templates and rate-card rules can generate standard media kits and commercial documents.
Teamleader supports CRM records and quotes signed online; this supports the standard commercial-document portion.
Salesforce reports 75% less quoting time internally, with no base or period stated; this is not a forecast for promotional materials.

assumptions: The company has reusable brand templates, approved copy and standard advertising terms.
Routine materials use approved assets rather than newly commissioned creative.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates for a limited pilot, not measured outcomes.
Access work includes GDPR review and employee consultation under national rules where applicable; formal consultation may exceed the range.
unknowns: Where current audience figures and media specifications are maintained.
Whether the installed systems support templates, exports and signature workflows.
Who can approve discounts, rights changes and contract exceptions.
Which employee consultation requirements apply.
research_questions: Which document sections are field substitutions, and which require original writing?
Can every audience claim be linked to a dated, approved source?
What share of contracts depart from standard terms?
new_work: Review tailored prose and unresolved brief fields.
Maintain approved copy, source dates and templates.
Handle contract exceptions and failed source connections.
Check generated document layout after template changes.

tasks.short: Arrange commercial recording sessions and accompany customers during production.

steps.what: Discuss recording needs, customer availability and production constraints.
Exchange availability with the customer, studio and production team.
Choose a feasible slot within the agreed production budget.
Confirm the booking, charges and calendar invitations.
Prepare and circulate the call sheet and customer instructions.
Accompany the customer and resolve concerns during the recording session.
Record agreed changes and assign follow-up actions.

tasks.design: A scheduling flow in the {WORKFLOW} collects availability, checks the {CALENDAR} and presents feasible slots with charges. After the seller approves a booking, it sends confirmations and generates a call sheet from the {DOCS}. The seller accompanies the customer and records decisions through a short form linked to the {CRM} and {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: External availability, studio terms and internal calendars were joined through email exchanges. Scheduling tools did not hold the production constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Forms, calendar rules and document templates already support the mechanics. Small integrations can connect them without a model or autonomous scheduling agent.
tasks.still_hard: Late changes, travel, customer reassurance and creative disagreements remain situational. Contact details need GDPR controls; production permissions and national rules still apply.
tasks.human_edge: Notice discomfort, explain production trade-offs and keep the customer and production team working together.
tasks.altitude: The seller handles fewer scheduling exchanges and arrives better prepared. Attendance and customer care still dominate the task, and decision rights do not change.

reach.task: Coordinate a production supplier against an agreed service scope.
reach.learn: Cancellation terms, production dependencies and when a scope change requires fresh approval.

evidence.claim: Availability collection, constraint checks and call-sheet generation can use deterministic workflows.
Customer accompaniment and live production concerns require human presence and situational judgement.

assumptions: Studios and customers can respond through a scheduling form or structured availability options.
Routine reminders and call sheets may be sent within an approved session workflow.
Booking approval time is counted in slot selection; the booking action carries the approval gate.
Time shares and build ranges are pilot estimates. Formal consultation under national rules may take longer.
unknowns: Whether the seller or production coordinator owns studio bookings today.
Whether studio availability can be read electronically.
Which bookings create cancellation charges or require supplier approval.
How much attendance time includes travel.
Which access and employee consultation requirements apply.
research_questions: Which constraints cause most failed scheduling attempts?
Can the booking flow prevent confirmations against stale availability?
Which session changes need customer approval rather than a routine update?
new_work: Resolve unavailable slots and late cancellations.
Maintain studio constraints, charges and instruction templates.
Correct contact details and failed calendar invitations.
Enter live session decisions without recording or scoring conversations.

tasks.short: Explain advertising artwork options and provide suitable samples.

steps.what: Ask about the customer's message, audience, assets and artwork budget.
Find current artwork specifications, service options and approved samples.
Select relevant examples and assemble an options sheet.
Explain examples, production trade-offs and the customer's preferred direction.
Send selected samples, specifications and next steps.
Record the chosen direction and artwork follow-up.

tasks.design: An approved catalogue in the {DOCS} tags samples by format, service level, usage rights and production constraints. A deterministic generator builds an options sheet from the artwork brief, and the seller selects the pack for delivery through the {EMAIL}. A guided form saves the customer's preference and design handoff in the {CRM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Samples were scattered and inconsistently labelled. Sellers relied on memory to find examples and explain their production limits.
tasks.enabler_now: Searchable metadata, reusable layouts and delivery templates are sufficient. AI-assisted coding makes a small catalogue and pack generator cheaper to connect.
tasks.still_hard: Taste, vague briefs and unrealistic expectations still need discussion. Sample rights and confidential customer work must be checked; GDPR applies where examples contain personal data.
tasks.human_edge: Translate a vague creative preference into a practical choice without promising an outcome the design team cannot deliver.

ambition.what: A monthly artwork clinic for first-time advertisers.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time searching and assembling samples and more time helping customers choose. They can run an artwork clinic using approved options; bespoke creative commitments still need design-team agreement.

reach.task: Run a short demonstration comparing advertising formats and artwork options.
reach.learn: Visual explanation, accessible examples and how to demonstrate differences without overstating results.

evidence.claim: A tagged catalogue and templates can assemble suitable sample packs without a model.
Creative preference and expectation-setting retain a substantial human conversation component.

assumptions: This task explains existing artwork services rather than producing original artwork.
Approved samples can be tagged with reliable specifications and usage permissions.
Pack approval occurs during options review and selection; sending carries the approval gate.
Time shares and build ranges are pilot estimates. Employee consultation under national rules is included where applicable.
unknowns: Whether samples are approved for reuse with other customers.
How artwork services, prices and turnaround limits are maintained.
Whether current document search supports the required metadata.
Whether first-time advertisers would use an artwork clinic.
Which employee consultation requirements apply.
research_questions: Which sample attributes best predict a useful customer discussion?
How often does the seller need design-team advice before explaining an option?
Can expired permissions automatically remove a sample from generated packs?
new_work: Tag and retire samples as formats and permissions change.
Review suggested examples and approve the selected customer pack.
Escalate bespoke artwork questions to the design team.

tasks.short: Gather bid material and coordinate commercial, contract and submission approvals.

steps.what: Read the tender and identify requirements, deadlines and contract conditions.

loop.input: Tender pack with attachment and page identifiers.
loop.output: Cited requirements, deadlines, required evidence and contractual exceptions.
loop.check: Check attachment coverage and source passages; seller verifies mandatory and ambiguous requirements.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair pass; unreadable or conflicting sections go to the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tender documents vary in structure and express obligations in free text.

steps.what: Create a bid checklist with owners, evidence needs and dates.
Request and collect pricing, audience evidence, credentials and delivery commitments.
Assemble the bid response and mark missing or exceptional commitments.

loop.input: Verified requirements, bid source pack, approved responses and bid template.
loop.output: Cited bid draft with gaps and proposed exceptions.
loop.check: Check requirement coverage, source support and exact price fields; contributors verify commitments.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unsupported answers remain blank and block readiness.
loop.why_not_simpler: Bespoke tender questions need tailored answers drawn from approved evidence.

steps.what: Route the bid for approval and chase outstanding responses.
Approve pricing, delivery commitments and commercial exceptions.
Review contractual deviations and clear acceptable terms.
Check final versions, submit the approved bid and retain the receipt.

tasks.design: A bid workspace in the {WORKFLOW} turns reviewed tender requirements into a checklist and collects versioned evidence from the {DOCS} and {CRM}. Bounded loops extract obligations and draft supported answers, while deterministic checks enforce completeness, pricing and approval status. Commercial and legal reviewers approve exact versions before the seller authorizes submission through the {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tender formats varied, evidence arrived through email, and approval status was separated from document versions. Automating the tracker alone did not solve missing or ambiguous requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded extraction can map free text into a reviewable checklist. Existing approval flows and cheaper integrations can connect evidence, versions and submission readiness.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous obligations, liability and unconfirmed inventory require human decisions. Customer portals may resist integration, and confidential bid data needs GDPR-compliant controls.
tasks.human_edge: Decide which commitments are credible and negotiate exceptions without weakening the bid or accepting hidden exposure.

ambition.what: A bid viability review whenever a material tender addendum arrives.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time chasing evidence and can revisit bid viability as requirements change. They can convene a timely review; commercial and legal approval rights remain with the designated reviewers.

reach.task: Prepare a bid or no-bid recommendation after a tender change.
reach.learn: Margin thresholds, delivery capacity, opportunity cost and contractual exposure.

reach.task: Prepare the booking handoff from an accepted bid.
reach.learn: Translate awarded commitments into order fields without treating unconfirmed capacity as reserved.

evidence.claim: Bid checklists, evidence collection, version controls and approval routing can use deterministic workflows.
Free-text tender extraction and supported answer drafting suit bounded model loops with human review.
Salesforce offers quote generation from a typed sentence; this supports quoting feasibility, not full tender compliance.

assumptions: The pilot covers a recurring tender family and a limited set of evidence sources.
Required approval roles vary by value and contractual deviation.
Submission automation uses a supported portal interface; otherwise the seller uploads the prepared pack.
Any material edit invalidates the affected approvals before submission.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates. Formal consultation under national rules may exceed the access range.
unknowns: Which tender formats and submission portals recur.
Whether source documents have reliable owners, versions and expiry dates.
Whether legal review is internal, external or required only for deviations.
Which commitments need inventory or production-team confirmation.
Whether portal access permits automated upload and receipt retrieval.
Which employee consultation requirements apply.
research_questions: Which missed requirements have previously caused rejection or rework?
Can each approved commitment be traced to its contributor and document version?
How should addenda reopen requirements, pricing and affected approvals?
Which readiness checks can be enforced without interpreting legal meaning?
new_work: Review extracted requirements and ambiguous obligations.
Maintain evidence owners, approval rules and response templates.
Resolve missing commitments and stale documents.
Handle portal failures and verify submission receipts.

role.altitude: The advertising sales agent moves from assembling packs and chasing responses toward campaign advice, creative guidance and bid viability. Customer conversations and production attendance remain substantial; new commercial or legal authority requires explicit delegation.
reach: Order clerk: prepare complete booking handoffs from signed advertising commitments.
Sales manager: prepare evidence-based bid viability recommendations.
Demonstrator and product promoter: explain artwork choices through practical examples.
skills_to_grow: Write structured campaign and artwork briefs.
Check audience claims, sample permissions and source freshness.
Recognize pricing, delivery and contract exceptions.
Review cited model drafts without accepting unsupported claims.
Maintain practical templates and workflow rules.
Apply GDPR, relevant EU AI Act duties and national employment rules to the actual deployment.
role.ambitious_version: Offer smaller advertisers a repeatable campaign refresh and artwork guidance service, while bringing material tender changes to commercial review sooner.
